note: Master SKU catalog transcribed from the Craftable item list — wine, liquor and NA Bev complete. 'cues' describe only what survives a bad shelf photo: bottle colour, capsule/cap colour, label colour, glass shape. Where two SKUs differ only by size, the cue says so — 1L bottles stand visibly taller than 750ml.
